H5.decision_rule: central VRAM <= 127 GB at one request per pass, weights streamed, AND central prove time <= 3,600 s per 1,024-token window
H5.packed_per_token_state_one_deltanet_segm: fits on the central assumption, not robust
fits, also on the high estimate
H5.packed_low_rank_chunk64: fits, also on the high estimate
H5.binding_constraint: the DeltaNet state trace: GPU memory of its largest segment, then total committed entries (share of committed entries that is DeltaNet mixer: 88% at T = 1,024, per-token state)
H5.how_to_read: r3 disclosure: the verdict strings in H5 ("fits, also on the high estimate", pass_, registered_expectation_held) are the REGISTERED RULE applied at the registered rates. They include segmentations chosen after the first run (post hoc) and the low-rank case, which is not established. They are not an answer to whether Qwen fits one H200: that answer is unknown (H5_r2.plain_answer).

H5_r2.label: EXTRAPOLATED, not measured; r2 after two reviews of PR #70

registered_verdicts_kept.first_run_per_token_4_layer_link: does not fit (138 GB central vs 127 GB)
registered_verdicts_kept.first_run_aggregate_H5: PASS, through the low-rank case only
registered_verdicts_kept.post_hoc_segmentation: exploratory: chosen after the first run was seen

H5_r2.low_rank: NOT ESTABLISHED: depends on a chunked low-rank construction that is not specified or proved (review of PR #71); this count also omits a second QK Gram, the staged G table, the P0/Q0 outputs and the M/o remainders, and uses remainder widths that the #71 review found too narrow. It is not the plan of record.
H5_r2.plan_of_record: boundary handoff of the full state at each chunk boundary, per-token cost (per_token_* cases)

own_small_example_rate.label: EXTRAPOLATED from a different, small synthetic model; not a Qwen requirement

H5_r2.wide_oracle_raw_gb_is: aggregate raw trace volume over all 48 DeltaNet layers and the whole window, not peak memory; not comparable with one card
H5_r2.high_and_upper_bound_are: labels of a registered range, not proved bounds; a DeltaNet entry is not known to cost what a dense entry costs
H5_r2.plain_answer: unknown: no measured Qwen segment exists. At the registered central rate some cases are under 127 GB; at this fork's own small-example rate no case fits a 1,024-token window (per-token state largest fit T = 256, low-rank T = 512).
